# MJP Hero

> A free, offline issue-spotting tool for lawyers practicing across state lines (multijurisdictional practice / MJP). Answer 14 questions and get a recommendation citing ABA Model Rule 5.5, ABA Model Rule 8.5, ABA Formal Opinion 495, and sourced state rules.

Not legal advice. Runs entirely in the browser with no network access (enforced by CSP) and no data storage; nothing a user enters ever leaves the tab.

## Primary page
- [MJP Hero](https://nkostelnik.github.io/mjp-hero/): the issue-spotter tool.
